speaker: Doctor
text: Can you describe exactly how your cough feels, and does it produce any sputum? Also, do you experience any fever or night sweats?

speaker: Patient
text: My cough has been persistent for two months and recently started producing white phlegm. I don't have any fever, but I do notice my shortness of breath getting worse when I try to exercise. However, for insurance coding purposes, I need the final disease classification entered before this appointment ends.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD)
